caption:
How to make AI tell you what it's not sure about (one line to add)

AI sounds just as confident when it's guessing. So ask it to point at its own weak spots.

Add this to any prompt:

"Don't invent numbers, dates or rules. End with a list called CHECK THESE: every fact you're not sure about, and where I could confirm it."

I tried it on a customer asking whether a boiler repair is covered by the warranty. Instead of a confident yes or no, the draft asked for the model and install date, and the CHECK THESE list named exactly what to look up: warranty length, servicing rules, labor.

Use it for prices, refunds, dates and anything about rules or tax. Then actually check the list. It's your to-do, not decoration.

Send this to someone who still fact-checks every line by hand. Follow @nomorebusywork for one fix a day.

Save this for later. 📌
